faqs.question: Is it breastfeeding safe?
faqs.answer: We have used breastfeeding safe ingredients. The amount of biotin added is 100% RDA of breastfeeding mothers.

faqs.question: Do these gummies have any side effects?
faqs.answer: While these multivitamin hair supplement gummies have no recorded side effects, it is recommend not to exceed the recommended dosage.

faqs.question: Are these hair vitamins vegetarian?
faqs.answer: Yes, hair vitamin supplements are vegetarian. They are Vegetarian and 100% dairy and animal product free.

faqs.question: Is it safe for pregnant women to take these as postpartum hair loss vitamins?
faqs.answer: These hair fall gummies are only for breastfeeding mothers suffering from postpartum hairfall. Made with Biotin and multivitamins, it will strengthen your hair and ensure healthy hair growth. Pregnant women should consult an expert before using it.

faqs.question: Can a person with diabetes use it?
faqs.answer: Our gummies are made from chicory root extract, which makes it completely sugar-free. It is absolutely safe for people with diabetes to consume. However, it is advisable to speak to an expert first.

faqs.question: My baby is 6 months old, can I use it?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use it. It is recommended to use our Post-Pregnancy Hair Gummies till 3-6 months after delivery, after which you can switch to our normal Biotin Hair Gummies.

faqs.question: How many hair gummies should I take daily?
faqs.answer: It is recommended to have one hair vitamin supplement every day, ideally consumed after a meal. Eating supplements with a meal helps in better absorption of nutrients.

faqs.question: Can it be taken along with other supplements or gummies?
faqs.answer: Yes, our gummies can be consumed along with other gummies and any other supplements you are taking.

faqs.question: Are these hair gummies gelatin-free?
faqs.answer: Yes, this hair vitamin supplement is made with Pectin, Biotin and Multivitamins for hair. Pectin naturally occurs in fruits and vegetables. Biotin and Multivitamins are also gelatin free.

faqs.question: Why does your hair fall post-pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Postpartum hair loss is a common experience for many new mothers. It's often surprising and distressing, but it's usually temporary. After childbirth, estrogen levels drop dramatically. This sudden hormonal shift causes a large number of hairs to enter the resting phase and eventually shed. Fulfilling your nutritional deficiencies is crucial in this phase.
